title: Gradient fill: preview and author gradient stops in ColorMixerPanel
description:
Gradient fills are already encoded to SWF (`packages/swf/src/shapes.ts` line 442+), rendered on canvas in the CanvasRenderer (`packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts` line 280–301), and interpolated in tweens. The ColorMixerPanel (`packages/authoring-ui/src/ColorMixerPanel.tsx`) has a gradient section with stop-list UI, but it has never been wired end-to-end for the authoring flow.

Acceptance criteria:
1. With a shape selected, changing ColorMixerPanel fill type to 'linearGradient' or 'radialGradient' creates a gradient fill on the shape's paths (via the existing `onFillChange` callback), and the stage canvas immediately shows the gradient.
2. Adding, removing, repositioning, and recolouring gradient stops (ratio 0–255) in the stop editor updates the live canvas without a full publish cycle.
3. The gradient angle field (for linear) and center-point offset field (for radial) round-trip correctly through the model and SWF encode.
4. A unit test in `@flash/swf` verifies that a shape with a 2-stop linear gradient encodes a valid FILLSTYLE type 0x10 record with the correct GRADIENT structure.

The ToolsPanel already has a GradientTransform tool (`id: 'gradientTransform'`, shortcut F); that tool is out of scope for this task.
